lines.text: Many learners say: I went to the market for buy fruit.
Better: I went to the market to buy fruit.
To buy! I went out to buy some milk.

data.wrong: I went to the market for buy fruit.
data.right: I went to the market to buy fruit.

native.tip: Tiếng Việt dùng “để” cho mục đích, nên dễ nói “for buy.” Trước động từ, tiếng Anh dùng “to.”
native.caption: Bạn có hay nói “I went to the market for buy fruit.” không? 😅 Trước động từ chỉ mục đích, hãy dùng “to”: “I went to the market to buy fruit.” Nghe thầy Carlos đọc rồi lặp lại nhé! Luyện thêm trong app Lexkite.
native.comment: Đáp án: “to buy.” Hãy viết một câu về nơi bạn đi và lý do, dùng “to buy.” Luyện thêm miễn phí tại đây: {link}

en.tip: Before a verb of purpose, use “to”: “to buy.”
en.caption: Do you often say this? “I went to the market for buy fruit.” Before a verb of purpose, use “to”: “I went to the market to buy fruit.” Listen to Carlos read it, then repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
